dict.string: OpenBots Next drives the apps you have granted a teammate: Mail, to read your messages and — with a card you approve each time — to send or answer as you; Contacts, to look up an address you have already saved, and nothing in Contacts can be changed; and Messages, to send a text from your own number, each one on a card you approve.

OpenBots Next reads the calendars of teammates you have granted it: what is on a given day, and who is on a meeting, so a teammate can answer whether you are free and write to the people you are meeting. Nothing in your calendars can be added, changed or deleted.
OpenBots Next shows the names from your Contacts beside your Messages conversations when you choose which chats a bot may read. Names are only shown to you; nothing in Contacts can be changed.
